'''Camp Aurek''' was an influential base for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jabiim/Legends|Jabiim]]. [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces later managed to capture Camp Aurek, [[Point Down]], and [[Outpost Shear]].<ref name="HNN 14:9:01" />
